name: Y STEAM Summer Program
description_short: A STEAM-focused day program for children entering grades 1-6, held at East School in Natick. Days run 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM and include hands-on science, technology, engineering, art and math projects, plus daily swim, sports and games.
refund_policy_summary: A $50 per week, per child deposit is due at registration and is not refundable. Deposits can be moved to other camp programs before April 1 but not after. The cancellation and transfer deadline is May 31; after that there are no refunds, credits or transfers. Extended care is paid in full at registration. A credit or refund (minus the deposit) may be given for an illness or injury lasting 3 or more days if you send a doctor's note before the session ends. All changes must be made in writing by email.
special_needs_notes: The MetroWest YMCA tries to make its programs accessible and asks families to share any needs in advance. It says it is not a therapeutic or special needs organization. Director of Inclusion: Laina Abolfazli, (508) 876-6094, labolfazli@metrowestymca.org. Children with chronic medical conditions or allergies need an Individual Health Care Plan.
swim_waterfront_notes: Campers travel to Clearbrook Pool to swim each day. Every child takes a swim test on the first day of each session. Red-neckband swimmers must wear a Coast Guard-approved flotation device during open swim. YMCA swim lessons and recreational swim are included.
